命题.notes: A statement judged true or false, never a school essay topic in this register: 命题为真/为伪 · 真命题/伪命题 · 测试命题 · 命题5号 · 信念命题. In 《黑暗森林》 all 44 uses are this one — the 思想钢印 plot turns on the single 信念命题 the Mental Seal is allowed to imprint. The essay sense is a verb (给学生命题) and rare.
命题.sentence: 命题为真按右手按钮，命题为伪按左手按钮。
命题.pinyin: Mìngtí wéi zhēn àn yòushǒu ànniǔ, mìngtí wéi wěi àn zuǒshǒu ànniǔ.
命题.english: If the proposition is true, press the right button; if it is false, press the left.
